parameters.name: CdnType
parameters.description:
The workload type of the domain name to accelerate. Valid values:

*   **web**: images and small files
*   **download**: large files
*   **video**: on-demand video and audio streaming

parameters.name: CheckUrl
parameters.description: The URL that is used for health checks.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names that you want to add to Alibaba Cloud CDN. Separate domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the system uses the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Default value: domestic. Valid values:

*   **domestic**: Chinese mainland
*   **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
*   **global**: global

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: The information about the addresses of origin servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn batch-add-cdn-domain --cdn-type web --domain-name example.com,aliyundoc.com --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --sources content_:_192.0.2.0_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:_80,_weight_:_15 --check-url url --scope domestic --top-level-domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn BatchAddCdnDomain --region cn-hangzhou --CheckUrl url --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyuji4b6r400' --Scope domestic --DomainName 'example.com,aliyundoc.com' --CdnType web --TopLevelDomain 'example.com' --Sources 'content_:_192.0.2.0_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:_80,_weight_:_15'
